method: Both source videos downloaded from their public QOVES posts. Every frame decoded and change-indexed (861 + 1373). Half-second contact sheets visually reviewed across both complete videos; selected source frames additionally reviewed at transition boundaries. Boundaries are editorial landmarks, approximate within several frames, not recovered source-project keyframes. Machine transcription was checked against visible phrase captions for structure; full transcript stays internal. No retention or causal performance claims were measured.

shots.title: Outcome preview over a fixed baseline
shots.observed: A large frontal portrait stays fixed while a thin vertical comparison boundary crosses the face. The altered state arrives immediately; an eye-like handle sits on the boundary.
shots.scriptConnection: The opening promises a visible counterfactual. It does not hide the outcome: subsequent narration explains how the impression is constructed.
shots.owner: Registered photo comparison / existing feature-study owner

shots.title: Feature crops assemble their own tray
shots.observed: Small white-bordered crops appear at their original face locations, then travel upward into a compact three-over-two tray. Each crop has a tiny caption.
shots.scriptConnection: The tray previews the variables that the narration will visit. It remains while changes accumulate.

shots.title: Restore the original before explaining
shots.observed: The wipe reverses toward the unaltered state while the tray remains independent. A cursor moves between the thumbnail and the relevant face region.
shots.scriptConnection: A controlled baseline is restored before individual changes are described.

shots.title: Brow explanation and cursor landing
shots.observed: The pointer visits the brow thumbnail, then the brow region. The portrait stays at the same scale and eye line while the local edit develops.
shots.scriptConnection: The named feature is targeted rather than making the entire photograph pulse.

shots.title: A material change rather than another shape warp
shots.observed: The cursor visits lips and the live portrait changes their fullness and colour/contrast. The tray persists; no global cut interrupts the explanation.
shots.scriptConnection: Geometry and colour are different operations. A brow/lip-density or tone change needs appropriate pixels, not stretched skin.
shots.owner: Reviewed edited-photo pair; photo samples via swatch-strip

shots.title: Cumulative lower-face adjustment
shots.observed: The pointer visits the jaw/neck crop and then the lower face. The apparent face/neck width changes over the existing cumulative state.
shots.scriptConnection: The narrator describes a relationship: the lower face gives the other features context. Removing this section requires resetting the cumulative state.
shots.owner: Existing reviewed edit owner + persistent tray

shots.title: Chin and facial-hair contribution
shots.observed: The pointer returns to the chin and stubble region, with local changes while the image and tray remain stable.
shots.scriptConnection: A changed visible beard edge must not be narrated as a measured skeletal change.

shots.title: A tool becomes the transition
shots.observed: A pale clipper enters from the side, rotates once and sweeps across the upper head. The hair image changes behind its travel; the tool then leaves.
shots.scriptConnection: The prop makes the grooming operation tangible. The reveal and prop share one progress clock.

shots.title: Label after the grooming reveal
shots.observed: A fine hairline contour and compact label arrive after the altered hair is visible. The image does not keep rotating.
shots.scriptConnection: Explain the result after the reveal settles; do not invent a hairline from eyebrow geometry.
shots.owner: Verified hairline contour required; local label owner

shots.title: Hold the cumulative result
shots.observed: The completed state and tray remain long enough for the final connecting clause.
shots.scriptConnection: A readable hold is part of the composition. More movement would compete with the argument.

shots.title: The tray clears before the conclusion
shots.observed: The small cards leave in different directions with slight staggering. The main portrait remains.
shots.scriptConnection: The visual mode changes because the explanation is over, rather than because a subtitle changed.

shots.title: Return to an explicit comparison
shots.observed: The original and altered states share a vertical wipe. Small labels identify each side and the headline distinguishes the altered dimension from overall preference.
shots.scriptConnection: The payoff reframes the experiment. It is a tradeoff essay, not a simple improvement claim.
shots.owner: Existing registered comparison / native caption owner

shots.title: Pull the comparison into a card
shots.observed: The large comparison shrinks into a rounded surface as more evidence becomes available.
shots.scriptConnection: Spatial continuity tells the viewer that this is the same experiment.

shots.title: Three-way resolution
shots.observed: Three distinct portraits arrange into a triangular comparison. Thin highlight frames move between candidates while the narration concludes.
shots.scriptConnection: A third, intermediate option tests the false binary. Our engine needs three genuine states; it may not relabel three poses as three controlled edits.

shots.title: An actual prediction surface
shots.observed: Four matched portraits are already visible in a two-by-two grid, with the same pose and different lip colours. A short question arrives above them.
shots.scriptConnection: The hook asks a concrete question while providing the evidence to make a prediction.

shots.title: Give the choice time to register
shots.observed: A small white circular indicator moves near the grid intersection and changes its sector/rotation. The portraits stay legible and still.
shots.scriptConnection: The mechanism adds quiet anticipation while the viewer compares. It is not a percentage or a score.

shots.title: The selected tile becomes the stage
shots.observed: One tile detaches from its grid position and expands toward full-frame scale. Other tiles leave instead of cross-fading on top of it.
shots.scriptConnection: The answer arrives through the evidence itself. The image identity is preserved through the move.

shots.title: Source page enters alongside the face
shots.observed: A research page slides in near the portrait, with a visibly folded corner and a small perspective change before settling.
shots.scriptConnection: The document arrives on the research claim. Its display is not independent verification of the study.

shots.title: A colour variable is made explicit
shots.observed: A segmented strip of shades sits above the head. Labels change with the named condition while the lip colour changes in the portrait.
shots.scriptConnection: The strip represents conditions. Our sample strip shows only actual photograph pixels unless supplied, reviewed condition colours are authored.

shots.title: Context enters as a hinged surface
shots.observed: The portrait leaves and a rectangular film insert appears from a narrow side-facing edge, rotating into a readable plane.
shots.scriptConnection: The argument changes from a controlled portrait to context; the source surface changes with it.

shots.title: Footage holds while the method is described
shots.observed: A short source clip remains in one fixed inset. A minimal source credit sits below it.
shots.scriptConnection: Do not fake a new scene with unrelated face movement; actual footage supplies context.
shots.owner: Existing media-asset video playback; source rights/credit required

shots.title: Freeze before a targeted illustration
shots.observed: A pause glyph is visible while the source image is held; a lip treatment is isolated and a short visual relation replaces the prior heading.
shots.scriptConnection: The visual comparison is synchronized to the result sentence. Do not alter the source person and call it an authentic frame.
shots.owner: Source-frame hold + reviewed edit + Torph text replacement

shots.title: Change the kind of evidence
shots.observed: A side exchange introduces a compact matrix of labelled circular swatches. It briefly loses focus as the next surface arrives.
shots.scriptConnection: The narration qualifies the first result: the colour category contains meaningful differences.

shots.title: Lift the underlying page
shots.observed: A source page containing a colour array and plots replaces the simplified swatches, then leaves upward.
shots.scriptConnection: Show where the conditions came from, but do not redraw a research graph with invented values.

shots.title: Introduce a second recognizable example
shots.observed: A new large portrait arrives from below the source page. Three small circular choices align near one side of the face.
shots.scriptConnection: The second example applies the same variable in a new identity and styling context.
shots.owner: Full-frame portrait exchange + swatch-strip vertical adaptation

shots.title: Select, demonstrate, restore
shots.observed: A cursor moves between the circular choices and the lip region. Different colour states appear with the same crop and expression.
shots.scriptConnection: The image tests the exact named distinction. A controlled edit remains separate from a change in pose.

shots.title: Use a counterpoint rather than another feature list
shots.observed: The portrait leaves. A smaller vertical creator clip enters with a short two-line contrast above it.
shots.scriptConnection: The story turns from an observed response to the person making the styling choice. This is an argumentative pivot.

shots.title: Let the counterpoint breathe
shots.observed: The genuine creator clip plays while the explanation continues. The surface stays stable rather than receiving unrelated face guides.
shots.scriptConnection: The counterpoint qualifies the first finding. A shorter cut must preserve it if removing it would reverse the argument.

shots.title: Product evidence follows delivered value
shots.observed: A large report surface arrives, and its own page content changes through several real examples.
shots.scriptConnection: The product is shown as a useful continuation of the explanation, rather than a generic early interruption. Our native reports stay full-screen.
shots.owner: Native report renderer / section scroll / component transitions

shots.title: Small resolved invitation
shots.observed: A compact domain carrier resolves after the product proof.
shots.scriptConnection: The closing invitation is brief and related to the value already shown. We retain Mogging’s own branding and CTA placement.
shots.owner: Existing Mogging invitation / domain text owner

sharedOwners: registered photo edits and wipe: feature-study.ts
source video: context-video.ts shared by photographic insets and Documentary Studio
report UI and scroll: mock-report.ts / report-choreography.ts
engine.generation: Qoves content style now defaults to editorial-story, alongside the retained feature-study recipe. referenceEditorialDirection is applied after saved-story directions, with asset/score/edit ownership retained. Authored presentations can select every family. Runtime phrase anchors resolve from the actual caption word times.
engine.scriptAndCut: The shared editorial-planning.ts brief reaches productionWritingBrief and the private story generation request. It distinguishes cumulative tradeoff, prediction/context and claim/counterexample structures. Independent examples can move; cumulative edits, revealed answers, qualifications and resolutions remain dependency-bound.
limitations: No new science claims have been approved from these videos. Reviewed scientific registry remains authoritative.
No QOVES footage, celebrity voice or branded outro is used in generated posts by default.
Photograph swatches are actual sampled pixels, not a shade recommendation or a skin-lightening filter.
The prop does not edit pixels. Texture/grooming transformations need a reviewed registered pair.

Genuine context footage uses one shared loader/seek owner for both Qoves insets and Documentary Studio. Source offsets, held frames and separate preview/export decoders are supported; source review and native crop resolution are checked before rendering.
Three angles are not three levels of an edit. A three-state controlled experiment needs three genuine reviewed states.
